kid_q: How much did the company earn last year, without the one-time stuff?
teen_q: Profit fell from 10,133 million rupees to 3,856 million. What was this year's profit with one-off items removed, and which document says so?

teen_a: BIOCON said the exact number is not in its record. It gave words but no figure.
kid_settle: Look at what wore out and what else came in, both years.
teen_settle: Depreciation and amortisation (the cost of assets wearing out) and other income for both years, in the annual report's profit and loss pages and notes.

teen_settle: The step from filed to like-to-like, in Rs million: annual report p6 and its defining page (cover letter 2026-07-15), or the Q4 FY26 results deck.

teen_settle: The FY26 annual report notes on inventories, payables (bills owed), other assets and receivables ageing would settle the 2,368 gap and give receivable days.

teen_settle: The inventories note in the FY2025-26 annual report (cover letter 2026-07-15): raw materials, work in progress, finished goods. The launch part needs a management statement.
